name: @poe2/data
description: Generated Path of Exile 2 game data artifacts and the scripts that extract them. Consumed by reading files from generated/, never by importing this package.
//: This directory sits under the packages/* workspace glob. Without a manifest npm treats it as a stray directory, which works until something in the workspace tries to resolve it. The artifacts are copied into apps/web/public by its sync-data script, so there is no main entry point to declare.

scripts.build:pob: node scripts/build-mod-tiers-pob.mjs && node scripts/build-pob-skills.mjs && node scripts/build-skill-levels.mjs && node scripts/build-tree-pob.mjs
